verdict.rationale: The evidence offers only scattered data-handling disclosures, not a documented security posture. The docs say session learnings are logged locally to ~/.gstack/projects/{slug}/learnings.jsonl. They also say agent-written domain skills are auto-injected into future prompt context, and that the browser path uses the user's real cookies and logged-in accounts. Telemetry exists and can be opted out of, but that is known only from a community thread, not first-party docs. Missing for 10: a first-party security/trust document, an explicit statement of what skills may execute, a trust model or vetting for third-party and agent-saved skills, first-party telemetry disclosure with opt-out instructions, and independent corroboration.
